eventDetail.scope: CEI 2026 will serve as a global platform for presenting, discussing, and advancing computer science, electronic information engineering, and intelligent control technologies. The conference will promote worldwide cooperation among experts, researchers, and academics, and will address the interdisciplinary integration needs of the three core fields. It will cover key areas including AI, machine learning, natural language processing, single-chip microcomputer and embedded systems, wireless communication systems, intelligent control algorithms, and robotic automation, and will feature keynote speeches from leading figures in the field, interactive sessions, and technical workshops to stimulate forward-thinking and collaborative breakthroughs. Participants will gain access to groundbreaking research, engage in in-depth discussions, and network with peers, all of which will drive innovation and scholarly excellence in these dynamic and rapidly evolving sectors.
